theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) mixed with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy)

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-heading font-medium tracking-tight text-[#2c1b18]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-heading font-medium tracking-tight text-[#2c1b18]
rules.small_label: text-xs font-body uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-[#8B0000] font-semibold

buttons.primary: bg-[#8B0000] text-white hover:bg-[#6a0000] rounded-sm px-6 py-2 font-body font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#8B0000] text-[#8B0000] hover:bg-[#8B0000]/5 rounded-sm px-6 py-2 font-body font-medium transition-colors

inputs.base: border border-[#8B0000]/20 rounded-sm focus:border-[#8B0000] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#8B0000] bg-white font-body

charts.patterns: Use minimalist AreaChart for revenue with #8B0000 gradient fill, BarChart for daily sales, and Donut/PieChart for category mix. Use very light grid lines (stroke='#8B0000' opacity=0.1).

login.layout: Split screen layout. Left side: image of luxury bakery interior with dark overlay (bg-black/30). Right side: centered login form on warm cream (#ede7c7) background.
login.details: Brand mark 'DADDY's' at the top of the form in DM Serif Display. Input fields for email and password. Primary CTA 'Access Terminal'.

pos_billing.layout: Left 70%: Top bar with category filters (Bread, Pastries, Cakes), below is a bento grid of product cards. Right 30%: Sticky Cart/Bill section.
pos_billing.product_card: Image on top (h-32 object-cover), title, price, add to cart button. Clean white card on cream background.
pos_billing.cart_section: White surface, list of selected items with quantity adjusters. Subtotal, GST 5%, Total. Big primary #8B0000 'Checkout' button, secondary 'Hold Bill' button.

dashboard.layout: Top: 4 summary stat cards (Daily Revenue, Orders, Top Item, Low Stock Warning). Middle: Large Line/Area chart for Monthly Sales. Bottom: Two columns - Recent Transactions table and Category Mix Donut chart.

inventory.layout: Full width list/table. Top right: 'Add Product' button. Table columns: Image, Name, Category, Stock Level, Unit Price, Status.
inventory.details: Highlight low stock items with a subtle red/warning badge. Use Shadcn Table.

employees.layout: Grid of employee profile cards or a clean table. Employee details: Name, Role (Cashier, Baker, Manager), Monthly Salary, Payment Status (Paid/Unpaid), Pay button.

retailer_payables.layout: Ledger style table. List of suppliers/vendors, Amount Owed, Last Paid Date, Status. Button to 'Settle Due'.
retailer_payables.details: Keep it very dense and clean, like a financial sheet. Use Manrope font for numbers for clarity.

online_orders.layout: Kanban style or status pipeline (New, Preparing, Ready, Dispatched/Collected).
online_orders.details: Cards show order source (Website), Items, Total, Customer Name. Button to 'Push to POS/Accept'.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements must use kebab-case data-testid (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='category-filter-bread').
